Product: CT QA portable Python compatibility test

Results.Name: The package contains a complete interpreter and verified local dependencies
The real CMD launcher works without system Python or inherited Python configuration
Both generated QA layouts are fully read with their report dates and printed observations
Moving the whole folder preserves operation at a Unicode path containing spaces
A selected local PDF is read without recording its identity or extracted private text
An unreadable selected PDF returns a separate scrubbed result without breaking the runtime test
An altered packaged PDF dependency is rejected before PDF analysis
The bundled Python and reader also run under an actual non-administrator token
The probe preserves all inputs and the main application files

Scope: Fresh generated Windows fixtures and the actual bundled interpreter launched through CMD. PATH excludes installed Python; PYTHONHOME/PYTHONPATH and shadow modules are poisoned. A separate ephemeral standard account is created only by elevated CI infrastructure, with no UAC or execution-policy change, and the child reports its actual unelevated token. Network denial is an application audit hook, not a claim of OS firewall isolation. Optional PDF canaries are checked against persisted output; no real reports, passwords or hospital access are used. Hosted execution does not establish a work computer application policy.
